objective: Improve source-acquisition precision before another matched native ContextBench quality/cost campaign and untouched superiority confirmation.
hypothesis: Giving GLM actual repository groups and then exact file names can avoid the vocabulary-to-naive-ranker mismatch seen in the rejected query-expansion screen.
research_transfer: Agentless section3.1 localizes files from repository structure, then code elements and edit locations. This prototype adapts only source-grounded file localization; it does not reproduce its embedding fusion, repair, test validation, models, population or reported results.

selection_evidence.attribution: 19 of21 novel reference-file occurrences were admitted by the existing index. Query generation was valid but source reach failed. This motivates testing source grounding, not a claim of causal diagnosis.
selection_evidence.distinctness: No BM25 rerun, broad relation-pool chooser, cross-encoder threshold retuning or workspace replay. The new inputs are complete admitted source-path inventory, not labels, historical predictions or generated source vocabulary.

construction_boundary.authority: Standing owner-directed private G02 research and GLM approval; D65 candidate research only, no product admission, activation, publication or deployment.
construction_boundary.product_frontier: Two strict public-JSON localization requests, compact complete path groups and exact packet-membership validation.
construction_boundary.operational_lane: WSL frozen source/evidence, VPS-only GLM credential and separately verified r2 transport.
deferred_residue: Untouched confirmation and reviewer claim approval

construction_evidence.packet_rule: Start with depth-three path groups; recursively split oversized nested groups into actual children. Compact parent/name tuples preserve every admitted path. Unsplittable groups fail closed. Each group at most20000 JSON bytes; any three selected groups fit65536 bytes. Both catalog and file packet have hard65536-byte caps. No truncation or language-extension exclusion.
construction_evidence.known_limitation: The inventory is complete only within the already frozen source index, not the whole repository. Two reference occurrences outside tracked base admission remain in the denominator. Construction is not localization quality.

prospective_screen_contract.cohort: All12 already-exposed cases, original ascending order; no replacement or unopened confirmation.
prospective_screen_contract.generator_inputs: Original issue plus source-only inventory; never Gold, patches, hidden reasoning, historical predictions, observed-path metadata, scores or credentials.
prospective_screen_contract.steps: One directory-group generation followed by one exact-file generation. Directory selection one to three exact catalog prefixes; file selection zero to three exact packet paths. Invalid JSON or membership is preserved without repair or retry.
prospective_screen_contract.proxy: New distinct reference-file reach, not native F1, semantic relevance or source-span evidence. All36 allocated slots remain denominator; selected previously observed paths receive no novelty credit and are not replaced.
prospective_screen_contract.control: Exact sealed original-issue unexpanded ranker control from query-expansion r1, with three previously-unobserved slots. Historical observations define scoring novelty only and are never model input. This is not a fresh native-engine comparator.
prospective_screen_contract.label_barrier: Seal all12 choices and verify every identity/digest before first isolated exposed label read. Unknown usage or uncertain provider dispatch stops, with no replay.
prospective_screen_contract.claim_ceiling: Exposed acquisition screen only. Even a passed screen requires a separately frozen equal-total-budget native campaign, then untouched matched confirmation.

execution_evidence.initial_observation: Case01 returned valid JSON but directory basenames rather than exact listed prefixes. It remained an invalid selection with zero credited files, no prefix repair or replay. All12 cases subsequently completed under the frozen contract.
execution_evidence.score_posture: Every12-case choice seal verified before screen Gold load. Terminal execution and independent binding/arithmetic audit completed; no processes remain live for r1.
execution_evidence.diagnostic: 17 selected files across8 valid cases,13 already observed and4 novel. Two novel files are reference hits. This descriptive2/4 ratio is not the frozen2/36 precision, cannot replace its denominator, and does not qualify r1.
execution_evidence.decision: Reject this exact policy's native advancement; no replay, prefix repair, case replacement, gate relaxation, native-quality or superiority claim.

next_candidate_plan.mechanism: Replace reconstructed directory prefixes with opaque exact group IDs; build available inventory from the agent's own current source observation ledger so it does not spend new-acquisition slots on already inspected paths.
next_candidate_plan.proxy_binding: A separate exposed screen may use the frozen historical control's legitimate observed-file ledger solely as a declared source-availability state. Both arms share that starting state. This differs prospectively from r1's issue/inventory-only generator; it must not be disguised as r1 repair or feed reference labels to inference.
next_candidate_plan.native_binding: A live native policy must use its own contemporaneous observations, never task-specific historical control files or Gold feedback. Equal total per-case model budgets still include localization calls.
dag: Construct and test exact-ID plus source-ledger inventory
Freeze distinct r2 screen with unchanged complete-denominator quality thresholds
Run all cases and seal before labels
Audit and reject or separately admit native testing
Only after native qualification: untouched matched superiority confirmation

open_questions: Can complete source-path grounding improve novel-file precision enough to meet the unchanged quality gate?
Does directory-first narrowing discard cross-directory evidence or increase cost without benefit?
Can any qualified file policy locate useful spans and improve full-denominator native F1 inside an unchanged total inference budget?
Will native gains survive fresh matched DSH and untouched confirmation?
